q: Is phosphoric acid from Paradip covered by CBAM?
title: Is Paradip phosphoric acid covered by CBAM?
short: No. Phosphoric acid sits under CN 2809, which is not on the CBAM list. Fertilisers containing nitrogen, such as DAP and many NPK grades, are covered. If acid is used to make DAP that goes to the EU, the acid's energy shows up in the DAP figure.
audience: Phosphoric acid and fertiliser producers at Paradip and buyers of Indian phosphates

ul: Mixed fertilisers with nitrogen under 3105, except those with only phosphorus and potassium.

p: EU buyers reporting Scope 3 may still want a footprint for the acid. Keep sulphur burning, steam and power records per tonne.

senseible: Senseible keeps each site's fuel, power and production records together, so the embedded emissions you send an EU importer trace back to dated documents.
